name: Concentrated Fate increases Echo Fragment's own effect value by 20% (#535)
contract: Concentrated Fate 706122 carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS (8) and EffectSpellClassMask0 word0 bit 0x10, which matches Echo Fragment 804455's own SpellFamilyFlags word0 (16). Native Player::ApplySpellMod should scale any effect of Echo Fragment by +20% (EffectBasePoints 19 resolves to 20 with DieSides 1).

Echo Fragment effect value unmodified without the talent
